sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Link previews: an artist's, label's, series' or collection's sidebar "Subscribers" link now has a card and a window, like an editor's subscribers: how many are subscribed, how many anonymously, and their names. The "Found in N user collections" link of any entity has one too: how many collections hold it, how many of them are private, and the first few by name and owner; the window lists every public collection with its owner, and a click on either opens their card.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Release and release group collections: the "plus N other private collections" row no longer comes back as a table row after a sort or filter; it stays folded into the line above the table. An entity in no collection no longer offers a Collections button with nothing to show, and neither does a subscribers page without subscribers.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: New pages: the "Found in N user collections" page of an area, artist, event, instrument, label, place, recording, series or work (the link in its sidebar) becomes a filterable Collection | Editor table, like a release's. The "Subscribers" page of an artist, label, series or collection becomes a table of its subscribers, like an editor's, with the anonymous subscribers counted in the line above it.
